runtimeRequirements: Resolve artifact_ref through the existing artifact service under the current owner/space; freeze the actual bytes, byte length and digest, MIME, filename, selected connection and attachment target before remote mutation. Do not accept personal paths, arbitrary URLs, model-provided bytes, part lists or resume upload IDs.

Read the actual bot.workspace_limits.max_file_upload_size_in_bytes from GET /v1/users/me or a verified current cache, and enforce the existing artifact-service limit. Validate current supported MIME/extension and 900 UTF-8-byte filename limit. No arbitrary product MIME list or 4 MiB file cutoff is introduced.

Auto uses single_part at <=20 binary MiB and multi_part above that when the actual workspace permits it. The documented large-upload guide permits paid workspaces up to 5 GB; actual reported workspace and existing artifact limits remain authoritative. Explicit incompatible modes fail clearly; nothing is truncated.

For multipart, derive number_of_parts from a deterministic 10 MiB segment plan. Every non-final segment is 5–20 binary MiB; the highest numbered final segment may be <5 MiB but is nonempty. Part numbers are contiguous and 1-based; offsets/lengths/digests cover the frozen artifact exactly. Do not send a made-up last-part flag.

Persist the same upload ID, artifact digest, planned segment hashes, dispatch state and reliable ACKs in the existing effect receipt. Complete only after every declared part has a reliable successful send receipt. Do not infer per-part commit from aggregate content_length or number_of_parts.sent.

On interrupted send, GET the same upload. If a part may have been dispatched but has no reliable ACK and no provider per-part proof exists, return UPLOAD_PART_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. Do not resend that part, complete from guessed state, create a replacement upload, or attach an unfinalized upload. Only a definitely never-dispatched segment can be sent once when resuming a frozen receipt.

If completion response is lost, GET the same upload: status=uploaded permits continuation to the original attachment target; pending without proven completion is unknown, expired/failed is unusable. Never restart creation or repeat an uncertain complete as if generic idempotency were documented.

Call complete with no request body. It can reject the combined size even after individual sends passed; retain the actual upload state and report that failure without attaching or silently recreating.
